alt: Chat: Roland, a company sent me a job offer on Facebook 🎉 They just want a small "registration fee" first. Congrats on the hustle 🙏🏾 but stop right there. A real employer pays you. You don't pay them.

Chat: But the letter has a government logo on it 😅 Logos and appointment letters are easy to fake. This month the NSITF warned that job adverts using its name are fake. It isn't recruiting and never charges fees.
Chat: Red flags 🚩 A fee for forms, training, medicals or "processing", An offer with no real interview Recruiter only on WhatsApp or Facebook, "Pay today or lose your slot"
Chat: How to check in 2 minutes ✅ Find the organisation's official website or verified page yourself. Don't use the link they sent. Look for the vacancy there. No listing? No job.
Chat: What if they only want my BVN and bank details "for salary"? Not before a real contract and a real interview. Your BVN, NIN and bank details are a scammer's goldmine.
Chat: One simple rule 🧠 If you have to pay to get the job, the job is the scam.
